== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Eithan{{!}}Eithan Arelius is an [[Underlord]] belonging to the [[Arelius family]]. He is characterized by his yellow hair and distinctive turquoise-and-gold robes. Known for being brash, proud, and occasionally arrogant, he possesses significant natural talent and has built a strong foundation of power. His abilities include the use of a spear, a [[Thousand-Mile Cloud]], and various veil{{!}}veils. He is noted for his ability to perceive hidden weapons and plans, making him difficult to prepare against. In combat, he has been seen utilizing three-colored lightning and specialized techniques. Despite his youthful overconfidence, he is considered one of the strongest young Underlord{{!}}Underlords in the Kingdom and potentially within the Akura clan{{!}}Akura's vassal states. He has demonstrated cunning by infiltrating locations in disguise to secure prizes and possesses the ability to command others.}}
